description: Plot the points representing given complex numbers (affixes) in the complex plane (xOy) relative to the orthonormal frame (O, i, j).

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math textbook, Chapter 1 (complex numbers, algebraic form) — exercises only

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{In the complex plane (xOy), plot the points representing the affixes of the complex numbers: } z_1=1+3i,\ z_2=-4+2i,\ z_3=-2-5i,\ z_4=3-4i.
exercises.technique: Plot the point M(a,b) for each z=a+bi, where a is the horizontal (real) coordinate and b is the vertical (imaginary) coordinate.
